testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss tab overflow without changing the active ribbon: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:338:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss tab overflow without changing the active ribbon ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full ribbon displayed ✔ And View is active but outside the visible tab row because the window is narrow ✔ When the user opens the ribbon tab overflow menu ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the overflow menu closes ✔ And the View command groups remain displayed ✔ When the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu ✔ And the user clicks the overflow control again ✔ Then the overflow menu closes and the View command groups remain displayed ✔ When the user reopens the ribbon tab overflow menu ✔ And the user clicks the visible Tools tab ✔ Then the overflow menu closes ✔ And Tools becomes active and its command groups replace the View groups ✔ And the part remains visible
